question: What is the architecture of their model?

extractive_spans: follow the architecture in berard2018end, but have 3 decoder layers like that in pino2019harnessing
evidence: Our ASR and ST models follow the architecture in berard2018end, but have 3 decoder layers like that in pino2019harnessing. For MT, we use a Transformer base architecture BIBREF15, but with 3 encoder layers, 3 decoder layers and 0.3 dropout. We use a batch size of 10,000 frames for ASR and ST, and a batch size of 4,000 tokens for MT. We train all models using Fairseq BIBREF20 for up to 200,000 updates. We use SpecAugment BIBREF21 for ASR and ST to alleviate overfitting.

title: CoVoST: A Diverse Multilingual Speech-To-Text Translation Corpus
